answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each agent to a Wesolowski VDF: it must execute a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with every result depending on the preceding one. Whether an identity is labeled lagoon, lantern, or jade, cloning it cannot shorten an individual chain by distributing its work across GPUs. The fixed sequential latency thus imposes a physical bottleneck that makes large-scale Sybil creation costly and time-bounded.
